items.title: Paladin and Archer choose their Modifier order
items.do: Update sheets from the compendium when prompted, then open Aveline's and Sylwen's Build tab and Class details / Swap choices.
items.expect: Both Paladin and Archer allow choosing Weapon +2 / Power +1 or Power +2 / Weapon +1. Aveline and Durgan carry Sworn Blade and Drawing Light at level 1; Sylwen and Kaela carry Steady Draw and Harrying Shot at level 1.

items.title: The 24 Basic Actions in the sheet grid and HUD
items.do: Open Aveline's Actions tab (Basic section) and select Aveline's token to open the HUD Basic tab.
items.expect: Basic Attack replaces Weapon Attack (Attack); Tumble is in Movement; Demoralize and Feint are in Control; Heal and Aid are in Utility. Trip, Shove, and Haul no longer show the Strike trait. Everything fits cleanly without clipping.

items.title: Basic Attack [Mod] on Tier 1 and 1[W] + 1[D] + [Mod] on Tier 3
items.do: With Aveline (Longsword) targeting the Orc Warrior, open Basic Attack. Check the card preview, force a Tier 1, then a Tier 3, and roll damage.
items.expect: Tier 1 deals [V] [Mod] Slash, Tier 2 deals [V] 1[W] + [Mod], Tier 3 deals [V] 1[W] + 1[D] + [Mod] (two exploding d6s + 9 + Mod). On Aveline's Basic Attack card, Sworn Blade's Strained line shows under Tier 3.

items.title: Fists fixed tiers and exploding 1d6!
items.do: With Durgan (free hand) targeting the Orc Warrior, open Fists. Check all three tiers and force a Tier 3 damage roll.
items.expect: Tiers show [V] 1 Bl / [V] 2 + [Mod] Bl / [V] 1d6! + [Mod] Bl. Tier 3 rolls an exploding 1d6! + Mod Blunt, and Durgan's Fists weapon item shows 0 / 2 / 1d6!.

items.title: Sworn Blade slides a Strained target on Basic Attack
items.do: Make the Orc Warrior Strained, then have Aveline use Basic Attack against it and apply damage.
items.expect: When damage lands on the Strained Orc Warrior, Sworn Blade's Strained line triggers and offers Slide the target 1 (can be declined).

items.title: Steady Draw adds +1[D] on Tier 3 against a pre-Strained target
items.do: Make the Orc Warrior Strained before rolling, then have Sylwen (Hunting Bow) target it with Basic Attack. Check the card and roll dialog notice, force Tier 3, and roll damage. Repeat against a non-Strained Orc Warrior (and on Tier 2).
items.expect: Sylwen's Basic Attack card shows Steady Draw's Strained line above Attack, the roll dialog shows the Steady Draw notice, and Tier 3 adds an extra 1d4! labeled Steady Draw. No extra [D] is added on Tier 2 or against a non-Strained target.

items.title: Drawing Light and Harrying Shot (Power Basic attacks & Critical 1d10!)
items.do: Have Aveline use Drawing Light against a Bloodied Orc Warrior (force Tier 3 Critical) and have Sylwen use Harrying Shot against a Bloodied Orc Warrior (force Tier 2, then Tier 3 Critical).
items.expect: Both deal Resolve damage with no [Mod] added and offer the Basic attack 1d10! Critical pick on Doubles + Tier 3. Drawing Light's Bloodied line appears on Tier 2 and Tier 3; Harrying Shot's Bloodied Daunted line triggers only on Tier 3 (not Tier 2).

items.title: Aid, Demoralize, Feint, Heal, Tumble, Trip, Shove, Kneel
items.do: Have Sylwen use Aid on Kaela, Demoralize on the Orc Warrior (Tier 3), Feint on the Orc Warrior (Tier 2 and Tier 3), and Heal on a hurt Aveline (Tier 2). Have Durgan use Trip (1 AP and 2 AP) and Shove (1 AP and 2 AP) on the Orc Warrior, and Aveline use Commandment (Kneel) on the Orc Warrior (force Tier 1 and Tier 2 Save).
items.expect: Aid shows a clickable Quickened 1 chip; Demoralize rolls Appeal vs. Appeal DC and applies Vulnerable 1 (1 round) and Daunted (EoT) on Tier 3; Feint differentiates Tier 2 (2 Boons), Tier 3 (Favored), and Critical (no Reactions); Heal rolls Appeal or Mind vs. DC 13 with Rally buttons; Trip and Shove each have 2 Versions with no Strike trait; Kneel applies Prone only on a Tier 1 Save and Hindered (EoT) on a Tier 2 Save.
